06 / Power

Power equipment: independence from infrastructure

Constraint: no grid at the remote site.

→

Solution: mobile battery stations of ultra-high capacity.

→

Result: an uninterrupted 24/7 production cycle in open field.

01Smart charging: charging systems with active cooling that protect batteries from degradation.
02Backup power (UPS): protection of RTK base stations and docks against voltage surges.
03Mobile power units: repeated charging of heavy drones in the field.
04Hybrid setups: batteries combined with generators for weeks of continuous operation.
